# Wonderwhy

> Audio news app with a short daily news briefing and news summary on topics you pick. Ask questions by voice, compare sources. iPhone, iPad and Android.

Wonderwhy is an audio news app for iPhone, iPad and Android: a short daily briefing from the topics you pick, voice questions while you listen, and a comparison of how sources cover the same story. Editions: United States, World, Türkiye, Spain and Germany. App languages: English, Turkish, Spanish and German. Published by Yelkovan.ai.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6817247112
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ay.wonderwhy

## Pages

- [Wonderwhy: audio news briefing & daily news summary app](https://wonderwhy.net/): Audio news app with a short daily news briefing and news summary on topics you pick. Ask questions by voice, compare sources. iPhone, iPad and Android.
- [Compare news sources on the same story · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/compare-news-sources/): See how different outlets report the same story: where they conflict, how each one frames it and what only one of them mentions. In the Wonderwhy app.
- [A daily news podcast made for you · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/daily-news-podcast/): A few minutes of daily news on the topics you pick, like a podcast. Ask about any story by voice and compare its sources.
- [Listen to the news on CarPlay · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/carplay-news/): Hear the day’s news in the car: the Wonderwhy briefing plays on CarPlay and Android Auto. Listen hands-free and pick up where you left off.
- [Today’s headlines, summarized · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/todays-headlines/): Short summaries of today’s top US stories, updated every day. Listen to the full briefing on Wonderwhy and ask about any story.
- [Support · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/support/): Get help with Wonderwhy, contact us, make a privacy request or delete your account.
- [Privacy Policy · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/privacy/): What data the Wonderwhy app and website collect, why, who processes it, how long it is kept and how to delete it.
- [Terms of Use · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/terms/): The terms for using the Wonderwhy audio news app and website.

- [Günlük haber podcast’i, sana özel · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/tr/gunluk-haber-podcasti/): Seçtiğin konulardan birkaç dakikalık günlük haber podcast’i. Dinlerken merak ettiğini sesle sor; aynı haberin kaynaklarını kıyasla.

- [Bugünün gündemi: kısa haber özetleri · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/tr/gundem/): Türkiye gündeminin kısa özetleri, her gün yenilenir. Haberlerin tamamını Wonderwhy’da dinle, merak ettiğini sor.
- [Destek · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/tr/destek/): Wonderwhy için yardım al, bize yaz, gizlilik talebinde bulun ya da hesabını sil.

## Español

- [Wonderwhy: noticias en audio y resumen diario con IA](https://wonderwhy.net/es/): App de noticias en audio: un boletín diario breve y un resumen de noticias con IA sobre tus temas. Pregunta por voz y compara fuentes. iPhone y Android.
- [Comparar fuentes de noticias sobre un mismo hecho · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/comparar-fuentes-de-noticias/): Mira cómo cuentan distintos medios la misma noticia: en qué se contradicen, qué enfoque da cada uno y qué menciona solo uno. En la app Wonderwhy.
- [Un podcast diario de noticias para ti · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/podcast-diario-de-noticias/): Unos minutos de noticias al día sobre los temas que eliges, como un podcast. Pregunta por voz y compara las fuentes.
- [Escucha las noticias en CarPlay · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/noticias-carplay/): Las noticias del día en el coche: el boletín de Wonderwhy funciona en CarPlay y Android Auto. Escucha sin mirar la pantalla.
- [Noticias de hoy, en resumen · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/noticias-de-hoy/): Resúmenes breves de las noticias de hoy en España, actualizados cada día. Escucha el boletín completo en Wonderwhy y pregunta.
- [Soporte · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/soporte/): Consigue ayuda con Wonderwhy, escríbenos, haz una solicitud de privacidad o elimina tu cuenta.
- [Política de privacidad · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/privacidad/): Qué datos recogen la app y el sitio web de Wonderwhy, para qué, quién los trata, cuánto tiempo se guardan y cómo eliminarlos.
- [Condiciones de uso · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/es/condiciones/): Las condiciones para usar la app de noticias en audio Wonderwhy y su sitio web.

## Deutsch

- [Nachrichtenquellen zur selben Meldung vergleichen · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/de/nachrichtenquellen-vergleichen/): Sieh, wie verschiedene Medien über dieselbe Meldung berichten: wo sie sich widersprechen, wie sie gewichten und was nur eines erwähnt. In der Wonderwhy-App.
- [Dein täglicher Nachrichten-Podcast · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/de/taeglicher-nachrichten-podcast/): Ein paar Minuten Nachrichten am Tag zu deinen Themen, wie ein Podcast. Frag per Sprache nach und vergleiche die Quellen.
- [Nachrichten hören mit CarPlay · Wonderwhy](https://wonderwhy.net/de/nachrichten-carplay/): Die Nachrichten des Tages im Auto: Das Wonderwhy-Briefing läuft mit CarPlay und Android Auto. Hören, ohne auf den Bildschirm zu schauen.
